items.checkpoint: Only the required parts, materials, WIP and stock present in the work area
Only the required tools and equipment are present in the work area
Only the required paperwork is present in the work area (signage)
Unnecessary items (furniture, shelves etc.) been removed from the general area
Has Red tag / Problem area concept being practiced / People are aware of it?

Is there no obsolete or old information ( order paperwork , bulletins , work instructions , standards , charts / graphs , etc. ) at the work station , in cabinets , on shelves , or on display boards ?
Locations for all parts, WIP and stock are clearly defined and labelled
Equipment and Tools are properly labelled and have a clearly defined storage location
Paperwork is properly labelled and has a clearly defined location available
Walkways, access to equipment, and work area boundaries are clearly defined and labelled
Are items at the workstation arranged by usage frequency and per ergonomic best practices ? Are the most frequently used items the easiest to reach at the workstation ?
Are signs in good repair ? Is the floor tape (if any) securely in place ? Are labels in good repair ? Is utility and PC wiring neatly routed ?
Is the shop floor clean and free of trash ?
Are the workstations and equipment clean ? Are the computer , printer , monitor , keyboard , and mouse clean ? Is all machinery clean ?
Are all forklifts and other material handling equipment clean ?
Are all pedestrian aisles clear and free of obstacles and trip hazards ? Are all drive aisles free of obstacles ?
Is all required cleaning equipment available & at designated place ( shadow board , cabinet , etc. )?
Are work area maintenance standard / SOPs prepared / Displayed? Work instructions and acceptance standards are correct, relevant
Have specific cleaning tasks been assigned? Are trash bins and scrap/recycle containers emptied on a regular basis with defined frequency?
Do the associates know and understand 5S ? When asked , do they know the standard process , checklist cleaning rules , process confirmation , etc. ) ?

title: Sustain ( Adhering to all Points and Improving them )

items.checkpoint: Audit Open point list maintained and shared with all the concerned personnel & Tracked for closure regularly
Recognition is given to teams who get involved in 5S activities
Time and resources are continually allocated to 5S activities
Has the team improved items that were not already identified on the pervious audit
